params.prompt: Cinematic photoreal scene, square 1:1, dark warm palette (#0B0907 shadows). A single old-fashioned toggle light switch on a dark textured wall, warm light catching its edge — a decision. The object sits in the lower third of the frame; the upper 60% of the frame is nearly black and empty for typography. No people, no readable text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark. Premium, calm mood.
